name: GISS-E3 20-year and 1-year sensitivity simulations
resolution: C180 (approx. 0.5 deg or 55 km), 6-hourly snapshots and monthly means
access: Jupyter notebooks used to do the analysis and data files necessary to reproduce figures are posted online at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5542663

scales.note: GISS-E3 C180 (~55 km / 0.5 deg). 20-year runs (1980-2000, 21 years = 6.63e8 s) plus 1-year sensitivity runs; output saved 6-hourly to monthly.
